ObicoNotificationType.description: The kind of printer notification Obico sent, normalized.

oneOf.description: The printer is waiting for a filament change.

Timestamp.description: An instant in UTC, as an RFC 3339 string with a zero offset.
Timestamp.title: Timestamp

description:
Obico sent a printer notification.

The two instants are optional for the same reason
[`ObicoFailureAlertPayload`]'s are, and are absent along with the rest of
the print's fields when the notification is about no print at all.

ended_at.description: When the print ended, when Obico reported an instant for it.

file_name.description: The file being printed, when the notification is about one.

obico_print_id.description: Obico's own identifier for the print, when the notification is about one.

started_at.description: When the print started, when Obico reported an instant for it.

title: ObicoPrinterNotificationPayload
